sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up older officer almost front-facing with a slight screen-right turn, balding high crown with sparse short silver-gray hair at the top/sides, pale gray brows, small thin oval wire-rim glasses with clear lenses and a broad thick silver-white upper-lip moustache. Keep cheeks, jaw and chin bare without a beard, and retain the calm firm closed mouth. No hat. Dark olive high-standing-collar tunic with a small central gold throat button, tiny pale blue-gray inner collar edge and large gold braided shoulder ornaments. Preserve complete pale gray-green painted rectangular backing, upper-left light, shoulders and crop. Source alpha249..255 is recorded; use compact broad yellow mascot head and very short neck naturally integrated with the closed uniform collar.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up clean-shaven older officer in three-quarter screen-right pose with eyes toward the viewer/right, a reserved stern closed mouth, full silver-gray hair swept neatly backward with a subtle side part and dark gray brows. Keep smooth bare upper lip, cheeks, jaw and chin with no moustache or beard; no hat or spectacles. Dark olive military tunic with folded high collar and fine stitched/striped edges, a small central gold throat button, narrow pale inner shirt edge and rounded gold shoulder decorations. No visible tie or added medals. Preserve original pose, hair shape, light, crop and continuous pale gray painted background over the full rectangle; source alpha249..255 is recorded. Fit the tunic closely around a short broad mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up older moustached officer in three-quarter screen-right pose, eyes slightly upward/right, neatly slicked-back black/dark gray hair with conspicuous silver front/temple streaks, thick dark brows and a full straight dark-gray upper-lip moustache. Keep cheeks, jaw and chin bare with no beard, serious closed mouth and no hat or eyewear. This exact variant wears an olive military jacket, gray collar patches with small pale/silver motifs, pale gray-blue closed shirt and muted olive-brown tie; retain this military outfit rather than the separate civilian dark suit/red-tie source. Maintain complete pale gray painted rectangular backing, original light and crop. Source alpha230..255 is recorded without treating the full painted background as a cutout; compact mascot head and short broad neck fitted into the original shirt collar.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up stern older officer looking upward toward screen-left, short gray hair at the temples under a broad dark olive/charcoal peaked cap and dark brows. Keep bare upper lip, cheeks/jaw/chin with no moustache or beard. Cap has a black band and visor, central gold crossed-shapes/crown-like badge and prominent gold leaf/cord embroidery across the visor; retain this exact cap variant. Gray-olive service jacket with long red collar tabs containing gold vertical trim, a small pale badge at lower screen-left, gray shirt and dark gray/black tie, with buttoned shoulder straps. Preserve pose, crop, lighting and full pale gray-green painted rectangular backing. Source alpha230..255 is recorded; use a compact yellow mascot head with short broad neck fitted naturally into the closed shirt collar.
